newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks flat at midday, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks flat at midday, trade slow.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were flat at midday on Thursday, as trade remained slow on a lack of fresh market factors, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was down 0.13 points, or 0.02 percent, at 730.02 points at the lunch break. Advancers led decliners by 46 to 40 with 69 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 157 billion rupiah.
"The market appeared to have lost steam after reaching a record high yesterday. Players are now standing on the sidelines waiting for fresh market factors," one broker said.
"Local investors are becoming very aggressive nowadays. We've got individual local clients whose buying orders are on a par with foreign institutions in terms of volume," the sales manager said.
Second-liners Sierad Produce, Bank Bahari and Anwar Sierad made modest gains in active trading due to speculative reasons, brokers said.
